merges.author: Linus Torvalds
merges.beneficiaries: Linux laptop users, owners of newer HP, ASUS, Acer, Dell and MSI laptops, system administrators
highlights: new model names and recent CPU support
more special button / function key handling
battery and hardware monitoring quirks
merges.summary: This merge brings 237 updates to Linux support for PC laptops, adding new HP, ASUS, Acer and Dell models and recent processors, fixing special buttons and function keys, battery and fan monitoring, improving Intel's tool for adjusting processor speed and power, and extending the built-in software interface used to control laptop hardware to work on non-PC processors as well.
merges.title: Merge tag 'platform-drivers-x86-v7.4-1' of git://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/pdx86/platform-drivers-x86
merges.whyItMatters: It matters because it makes newer laptops work more correctly out of the box, with working keys, cooling, battery reporting and power controls, instead of users needing workarounds for missing hardware support.

merges.author: Linus Torvalds
merges.beneficiaries: people who build Linux, developers working on camera and TV hardware, users of media devices that rely on those chip connections
merges.summary: This merge undoes a previous change that hid media drivers using I²C (a common way for chips inside a device to talk to each other) or SPI (another way for chips to talk to each other) from the configuration menu for the Linux kernel (the core software that manages hardware) by default, so those drivers are visible and selectable again.
merges.title: Merge tag 'media/v7.4-2' of git://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/mchehab/linux-media
merges.whyItMatters: This matters because people building Linux can again easily discover and enable support for cameras, TV tuners, and other media devices that connect through those chip communication methods, instead of those options being hidden unless a special setting was found.

highlights: Better document descriptor flags and clarify ordering rules around
New APIs to start hiding dmaengine guts so that we can start making
Nord and Maili GPI DMAengine support
DW axi dma updates and support for UltraRISC DP1000 controller
merges.summary: This merge brings 149 changes to the Linux kernel's direct memory access framework (the system that lets hardware move data to and from memory without tying up the main processor), adding cleaner programming interfaces that hide internal details and support for new data-movement hardware in Apple M3, Amlogic A9, Allwinner A733, UltraRISC DP1000, Nord, and Maili devices plus improvements to existing data-movement hardware.
merges.title: Merge tag 'dmaengine-7.4-rc1' of git://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/vkoul/dmaengine
merges.whyItMatters: It matters because devices can transfer data more efficiently with less processor work, new hardware gains working Linux support sooner, and developers get a simpler and more maintainable foundation for future data-movement features.

highlights: Rockchip rk3576 csi dphy support
Mediatek MT8195, MT8196 DisplayPort PHYs. MT8196 PCI-Express Gen4
Qualcomm Nord eUSB2, QMP USB PHY, QMP PCIe and Gen5x16 PHY support,
New driver for Qualcomm CSI2 C-PHY/DPHY support and new APIs in
merges.summary: This merge adds and improves support for the low-level hardware interfaces, called PHYs, that translate electrical signals for connections such as USB, video, and camera links, across many new chips from Qualcomm, MediaTek, Rockchip, Nvidia, Google, and others.
merges.title: Merge tag 'phy-for-7.4' of git://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/phy/linux-phy
merges.whyItMatters: It matters because without these drivers, devices built on those chips could not reliably use their USB, video, storage, or camera ports, so this update lets new hardware work properly with Linux.

merges.author: Linus Torvalds
merges.beneficiaries: Lenovo Yoga and Surface Pro users, users of future Qualcomm Shikra devices, engineers maintaining laptop audio and power management
highlights: CLOCK_STOP_MODE1 support in bus and Intel driver
DMI quirks for disabling ghost on Lenovo Yoga 7 Pro, Lenovo Yoga
Few more codecs as wake capable, tac5xx2 family, rt718, rt766/rt767
Qualcomm Shikra SoC support
merges.summary: This merge updates SoundWire, the internal connection that links audio chips inside a computer, to add a low-power mode that stops the audio clock during system sleep, to ignore phantom audio chips falsely reported on several Lenovo laptops and a Surface Pro tablet, to allow more audio chips to wake the computer from sleep, and to add support for Qualcomm's new Shikra chip platform.
merges.title: Merge tag 'soundwire-7.4-rc1' of git://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/vkoul/soundwire
merges.whyItMatters: It matters because it should extend battery life, make sleep and wake-up more reliable, avoid errors and slowdowns caused by hardware that is not actually present, and enable sound on upcoming devices built around the new Qualcomm platform.

merges.title: Merge tag 'rpmsg-v7.4' of git://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/remoteproc/linux
merges.whyItMatters: It matters because it makes communication between processors more flexible and efficient, prevents a sender from getting stuck or wasting memory when it is interrupted or times out, and helps developers understand and use the system correctly.

cves.description: In two places, current code forces vmbus_connection.conn_state to DISCONNECTED prior to calling vmbus_disconnect(). But vmbus_disconnect() calls vmbus_initiate_unload(), which unloads the VMBus connection only if the conn_state is CONNECTED. Consequently, the connection remains and the Hyper-V host might continue to send messages or post VMBus interrupts.
cves.title: Drivers: hv: Don't reset VMBus connection state on error/exit paths

cves.description: Once a power supply is registered, its callbacks can immediately start firing from other contexts, such as external_power_changed() triggered by the TCPM stack. cves.title: power: supply: core: prevent unregistering a power supply while a callback runs

cves.title: drm/vc4: hdmi: Move packet RAM enable to PM runtime
